findings.claim: Binance's October 30 19:33 UTC Security Incident Update #2 states approximately $6.3B impact, more than $6.34B company funds set aside, $5B held in exact affected token assets and remaining relevant token assets being acquired through market and OTC channels; approximately $3B was reported frozen on-chain.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: These are company/partner aggregate statements, not independently audited balances. No XRP-specific allocation, purchase fill, execution venue or settlement quantity is disclosed.

findings.claim: Binance's update targeted an initial Proof of Reserves snapshot approximately 12 hours after the 19:33 UTC update, results by November 2 and withdrawal-service restoration within approximately 34 hours subject to security checks.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: At the 05:05 UTC cutoff the initial 07:33 UTC snapshot target had not yet arrived and no verified withdrawal resumption was found. These are targets, not completed events.

findings.claim: Investing.com daily XRP data show October 29 close $1.2348 (-6.84%) and October 30 close $1.2499 (+1.22%).
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Daily candles cannot identify the causal contribution of the Binance incident; the Oct29 candle includes multiple market and macro drivers.

findings.claim: Kodexius at 00:14 UTC reports $739.41M XRP perpetual open interest across seven contracts, +0.0068% weighted funding per eight hours and $1.94B 24-hour volume; TradRadar at 23:20 UTC Oct30 reports $1.85B across seven exchanges, +0.0027% funding and at least $14.14M 24-hour liquidations.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Contract/venue universes and timestamps differ. The values must remain provider-specific and must not be averaged.

findings.claim: Main head ab053b0 is an unsigned Cross-analysis refresh commit at 04:52:02 UTC, parent df35e4e, changing only ping-pongings/knowledge-base/sentiment_shift.json. The generated file has zero XRP and BTC entries and null recent/prior scores.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: No associated Actions run was returned. The workflow code and commit message/path strongly support Cross-analysis attribution, but the exact triggering event and run are not linked.

findings.claim: Main contains scheduled write-capable workflow configurations for Cross-analysis, signal-accuracy, scheduler-tick, autonomous self-deployment, subscriber sync, cognitive PingPong, Riemann harvest, Gumroad metrics, WebMCP live sandbox, WebMCP monetization enrichment and transparency audit. Hover-bike updates also has a schedule and contents:write permission, but its mutation target was not established.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: This is a targeted code-search/file-read inventory, not a complete audit of all workflows, repository defaults, rulesets, token permissions or actual run histories. Some workflow triggers may not produce a commit every time.

findings.claim: PR #1395 was opened from current main ab053b0 as a draft read-only scheduler queue audit. Its exact head cf85491 passed 344 tests plus 8 subtests and the fail-closed gate; merge remained disabled.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: PR remains open, draft and unmerged. The proposed change intentionally suspends automatic queue dispatch; it does not disable other scheduled main writers.

findings.claim: PR #1392's exact head passed 388 tests plus 8 subtests and its fail-closed gate; PR #1393's exact head passed 349 tests plus 8 subtests and its fail-closed gate.
findings.counterevidence_or_limit: Both remain open, draft and unmerged. PR #1393's live Morpho API was not executed; PR #1392 leaves the scheduler queue write path in its current proposal and does not address all other scheduled writers.

Targeted GitHub code search found multiple active scheduled write-capable workflows; full workflow/token/ruleset audit and full open-PR recount remain incomplete.

prediction_engine.reason: Daily XRP candles and two non-comparable derivatives aggregators do not form a synchronized leakage-safe feature set. Binance XRP replacement quantity and current attacker-receiver state remain unknown.

actual_capital_controls: The $6.34B reserve and $5B already-held affected tokens are aggregate company claims, not XRP purchase quantities.
The approximately $3B frozen amount is separate from Binance's reserve plan and is not equivalent to recovered funds.
Do not infer XRP market demand from a purchase plan without token-level fills, reserve-address changes or disclosed execution evidence.
Do not average provider-specific OI values until contract and venue coverage are reconciled.
Do not use daily candle changes to attribute the Binance incident without an event study and BTC/ETH controls.
No market observation in this snapshot is admitted to the prediction model.
notes: The 24-source append is immutable and append-only. PR #1395 is a tested safety proposal, not an active main-branch fix until approved and merged. Main still has multiple scheduled write-capable workflows. No forecast issued.
